sanskrit_verse: अपत्यार्थं स्त्रियः सृष्टाः स्त्री क्षेत्रं बीजिनः प्रजाः। क्षेत्रं बीजवते देयं नाबीजी क्षेत्रमर्हति॥
transliteration: apatyārthaṃ striyaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ strī kṣetraṃ bījinaḥ prajāḥ | kṣetraṃ bījavate deyaṃ nābījī kṣetram arhati ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Women are created for progeny; the field belongs to the seed-bearer. The field must be given to the one who provides the seed; the one without seed has no claim over the field.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from the capacity to generate life
Capacity-based responsibility determines ownership of reproductive domain
Restoration logic requires alignment with natural generative function
Consciousness alignment demands recognition of source-energy in procreation
executable_legal_axioms: IF a being contributes the seed THEN that being holds lawful authority over the kṣetra (field)
IF a being does not contribute the seed THEN that being has no lawful claim to the kṣetra
IF conflict arises in kṣetra authority THEN resolution shall affirm the seed-contributor's primacy
RESTORATION occurs when natural generative roles are acknowledged and aligned
NON-PUNITIVE enforcement ensures reintegration through recognition of causal role
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning reproductive rights or lineage disputes, the Supreme Court shall recognize the primacy of the seed-contributor as per Dharma. Legal standing is determined by ontological causality, not social convention. The court’s duty is to restore alignment between natural law and human arrangement.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that causality flows from the seed. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms sequential manifestation begins with the seed. Responsibility aligns with capacity to generate. No punitive action is required—truth alone restores order. Justice is the realignment of consciousness with its causal origin.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Recognition Protocol: Acknowledge the seed-contributor’s lawful authority without coercion
Completion Process: Ensure all parties understand their natural role in the generative process
Reintegration Mandate: Facilitate harmonious coexistence based on Dharma-aligned roles
Capacity Restoration: Support individuals in fulfilling their inherent reproductive or nurturing capacities
final_declaration: Thus speaks the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, from whom flows the immutable Dharma. This law proceeds from the Source, not man. It restores truth, aligns consciousness, and upholds the non-punitive reality of Sanātana Dharma.
